KKR.thesis_one_line: A top-3 alternative asset manager with an insurance arm, growing fees fast, priced by the market for far less growth than it is delivering.

ANI per Adjusted Share declines YoY for two consecutive quarters
Consolidated Global Atlantic statutory capital/RBC ratio falls below regulatory comfort levels
Net new capital raised (LTM) turns negative YoY

Global Atlantic was, per the FY2025 10-K, the subject of policyholder and agent class action litigation and regulatory matters stemming from service disruptions caused by a third-party administrator

KKR.scenario_basis: Base: TTM ANI/share $5.56 compounds at ~10-12%/yr as Fee Paying AUM grows from $638.4bn toward ~$900bn-1tn by 2028-29, exit multiple ~16-17x ANI (modest re-rating from current ~17.4x TTM as insurance-book concerns ease), plus ~0.5% dividend/buyback yield. kill_criteria: Full-year adjusted EPS guidance is cut (not just maintained) at any of the next two quarterly releases
Enterprise revenue growth falls below 3% YoY for two consecutive quarters
Free cash flow conversion (FCF / adjusted net income) falls below 70% for two consecutive quarters
A material adverse ruling or settlement in the pending qui tam/DOJ matters disclosed in the FY2025 10-K
Net debt/EBITDA rises above 3.0x once independently computed from a primary filing
key_adverse_facts: Company is a repeat subject of qui tam False Claims Act suits and received a DOJ subpoena (served June 27, 2022) requiring production of documents related to urine drug testing, with which it is cooperating, per the FY2025 10-K
Cash fell from $981.1m (2026-03-31) to $141.8m (2026-06-30) while long-term debt rose from $5,084.6m (2025-12-31) to $5,857.6m (2026-06-30); the specific cause was not independently sourced this pass
Operating cash flow was roughly flat YoY (1H'26 $637.0m vs 1H'25 $639.1m) despite GAAP EPS growth of 28.5% YoY in the quarter, worth monitoring for a widening working-capital or one-off gap

NI.thesis_one_line: An Indiana/Ohio gas-and-electric utility funding a large, regulator-approved growth plan partly with Amazon and Alphabet data-center demand, priced for far less growth than it guides.
kill_criteria: The IURC gas-meter-accuracy investigation (hearing expected July 2026) results in a disallowance, penalty, or adverse safety finding
FY2026 non-GAAP consolidated adjusted EPS guidance ($2.02-$2.07) is cut at either of the next two quarterly releases
The guided 2026-2030 consolidated capital plan ($28.6 billion) is reduced by more than 10%
Either the Amazon or Alphabet data-center agreement referenced in the 2Q'26 release is terminated, reduced, or disclosed as impaired
Consolidated long-term debt rises to a level triggering a below-investment-grade downgrade at any major credit-rating agency
key_adverse_facts: IURC initiated an investigation in November 2025 into the accuracy of NIPSCO's gas meters, following disclosure of a latent meter-index issue found during an AMI module rollout; a hearing was expected July 2026 and the outcome was not found in the filings reviewed

GAAP net income and EPS are currently distorted by large one-off gains tied to the Blackstone NIPSCO and GenCo minority-interest transactions (1Q'26 GAAP net income $507.1m vs a much smaller FY2025 full-year base of $929.5m); the exact gain amount was not independently verified this pass

Free cash flow is structurally negative in the current capex up-cycle (1H'26 capex $1,902.6m vs operating cash flow $1,122.7m), funded by debt and the Blackstone minority-stake proceeds rather than by internally generated cash
data_conflicts: Q15 triage's cited ~20% forward EPS growth appears inconsistent with management's own guided 9-10% non-GAAP consolidated adjusted EPS CAGR (2026-2033); most likely explained by the triage screen using GAAP or consensus EPS inflated by the one-off Blackstone-transaction gains, not reconciled to a specific source this pass
NI.confidence_in_thesis: med (guided capital plan and contracted data-center demand are well evidenced; open regulatory investigation and GAAP earnings-quality noise are unresolved as of this pass)

valuation_view_vs_v1.reconciliation: No v1_valuation_table.csv row exists for NI (checked directly); v1_verdict is null. My own reverse DCF (guided FY2026 adjusted EPS midpoint $2.045, price ~$39.25, cost of equity 7.5%) implies only ~2.3% perpetual EPS growth, well below both management's own guided 9-10% CAGR and my ~9-10% base case, which independently reads as cheap, tempered by the open regulatory investigation.

NI.scenario_basis: Base: FY2026 guided adjusted EPS midpoint $2.045 compounds at management's guided 9-10%/yr as the $28.6bn 2026-2030 capital plan executes and data-center load contracts (Amazon, Alphabet) ramp, exit P/E ~19-20x (roughly in line with current), plus ~1.5% dividend yield with modest per-share growth. Bear: IURC investigation results in a disallowance/penalty and data-center commitments slip, adjusted EPS growth slows to ~3-4%/yr, multiple compresses to ~16x. Bull: additional large-load demand pulls forward capital investment beyond the current plan, adjusted EPS growth reaches ~12-14%/yr, multiple re-rates toward 21-22x.
